description:
Register the brief's ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST — the machine-checkable claims that must hold before the work counts as done. Do this right after intake, before the first edit: extract from the brief every required output file, every string of approved copy that must land verbatim, and note the constraints only you can check. Skip it only when the brief fixes no outputs or copy.

Item kinds:
- { kind: 'output', path } — a file that must exist when the work is delivered (absolute path, e.g. every variant the brief orders exported with `outPath`).
- { kind: 'copy', text } — approved copy that must appear VERBATIM in the design's text (whitespace variants are folded; wording, case and punctuation are exact).
- { kind: 'note', text } — a self-check the server cannot verify. Kept on record; never machine-checked.

Every `export` checks the list against the design and the disk and names the unmet items — treat one exactly like a failing test. Calling `checklist` again REPLACES the whole list; it lasts for this conversation.

Returns `{ itemCount }`, or `{ items }` (the current list) when called without `items`.

items.description: The full checklist (at most 64 items); replaces the current one. Omit to read the current list.

name: checklist
